title: Grateful Dead Live at Honolulu Civic Auditorium on 1970-01-23

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy Hawaiian show with wailing Jerry Garcia, standout China Cat Sunflower and Black Peter performances.
ai_review.review: The Goodbear SBD delivers crystal‑clear audio that lets you hear every cowbell, Pigpen’s organ and Jerry’s soaring guitar. The concert bursts with 1969‑era energy – a ripping China Cat Sunflower, dynamite Black Peter, a powerful Hard to Handle (despite a lyric slip) and a phenomenal Lovelight. Overall the performance is vibrant and the recording quality is top‑notch.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (average 4.3) combined with repeated praise for excellent soundboard audio and a strong, energetic performance; only minor lyrical slip noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: SBD is described as crystal‑clear, well‑balanced with crisp organ, cowbells and Jerry’s guitar tone; no significant dropouts or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy, 1969‑style set that flows smoothly and captures the fun of a Hawaiian gig; strong transitions and vibrant vibe throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for wailing guitar tone and leading vocals, especially on China Cat Sunflower.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ highlighted as top form, adding texture to the early songs.
